reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    Jurisdiction: Illinois
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: Is it required that the eviction summons served to tenants state the amount owed?
*/

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Basic list utilities (self-contained; no modules)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

list_member(X, [X|_]) :- !.
list_member(X, [_|T]) :- list_member(X, T).

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Statute translations (deterministic predicates)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  735 ILCS 5/9-118(c)
  "The summons shall advise the defendant that a hearing on the complaint
   shall be held at the specified date and time, and that the defendant should
   be prepared to present any evidence on his or her behalf at that time."
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_118_summons_required_content(hearing_date_and_time) :- !.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_118_summons_required_content(prepared_to_present_evidence) :- !.

/*
  735 ILCS 5/9-118(b)
  Encodes the applicability conditions in a simplified, explicit way.
  This statute is a special "emergency housing eviction proceeding" statute.
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_118_applies(Scenario) :-
    scenario_fact(Scenario, proceeding_type, emergency_housing_eviction),
    scenario_fact(Scenario, complaint_seeks_possession_of_premises, yes),
    scenario_fact(Scenario, premises_owned_or_managed_by_housing_authority_or_private, yes),
    scenario_fact(Scenario, verified_complaint_alleges_direct_evidence_of_enumerated_crime, yes),
    scenario_fact(Scenario, notice_by_verified_complaint_served_at_least_14_days_before_hearing, yes),
    scenario_fact(Scenario, proof_of_service_submitted_to_court, yes),
    !.

/*
  735 ILCS 5/9-107
  Constructive service notice requirements:
  "Such notice ... shall state the nature of the cause ... at whose instance issued
   and the time and place for trial ... and shall also state that unless the
   defendant ... appears ... judgment will be entered by default, and shall specify
   the character of the judgment that will be entered ..."
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_notice_required_content(nature_of_cause) :- !.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_notice_required_content(at_whose_instance_issued) :- !.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_notice_required_content(time_and_place_for_trial) :- !.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_notice_required_content(default_judgment_warning) :- !.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_notice_required_content(character_of_judgment) :- !.

/*
  735 ILCS 5/9-107 (limitation on judgments when constructive service and no appearance):
  If constructive service by posting/mailing or publication/mailing and defendant does not appear generally,
  court may rule only on eviction (possession) portion and shall not enter judgment as to any rent claim.
*/
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_limits_rent_judgment(Scenario, yes) :-
    scenario_fact(Scenario, service_type, constructive),
    scenario_fact(Scenario, defendant_appears_generally, no),
    !.
statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_limits_rent_judgment(_Scenario, no) :- !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Scenario encoding (facts for the question's factual statement)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/* Scenario identifier */
scenario_id(s1) :- !.

/*
  Facts representing the question scenario.
  The question provides only that an eviction summons is served to tenants, and asks
  whether it must state the amount owed.

  We encode a typical non-emergency eviction case with personal service; the result
  under the provided statutes does not change (neither 9-118 nor 9-107 requires the
  summons/notice to state the amount owed).
*/
scenario_fact(s1, state, illinois) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, focus_year, 2021) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, eviction_summons_served_to_tenant, yes) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, service_type, personal) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, proceeding_type, standard_eviction) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, claim_for_rent_joined_in_complaint, unknown) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, defendant_appears_generally, unknown) :- !.

/* Emergency 9-118-specific applicability facts (not an emergency proceeding here) */
scenario_fact(s1, complaint_seeks_possession_of_premises, yes) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, premises_owned_or_managed_by_housing_authority_or_private, unknown) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, verified_complaint_alleges_direct_evidence_of_enumerated_crime, no) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, notice_by_verified_complaint_served_at_least_14_days_before_hearing, unknown) :- !.
scenario_fact(s1, proof_of_service_submitted_to_court, unknown) :- !.

/* Helper predicate required by the task: succeeds when the factual statement is satisfied. */
scenario_statement :-
    scenario_id(S),
    scenario_fact(S, state, illinois),
    scenario_fact(S, focus_year, 2021),
    scenario_fact(S, eviction_summons_served_to_tenant, yes),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Applying statutes to the scenario (reasoning helpers)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

/*
  Determine which contents are legally required in the summons/notice in this scenario,
  based ONLY on the provided statutes (9-118 and 9-107).
*/
required_summons_or_notice_content(Scenario, Content) :-
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_118_applies(Scenario),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_118_summons_required_content(Content),
    !.
required_summons_or_notice_content(Scenario, Content) :-
    scenario_fact(Scenario, service_type, constructive),
    statute_735_ilcs_5_9_107_notice_required_content(Content),
    !.

/*
  The specific legal question: is "amount owed" required to be stated in the summons/notice?
  Under the provided statutes, that would be true only if "amount_owed" is among required contents.
*/
summons_must_state_amount_owed(Scenario) :-
    required_summons_or_notice_content(Scenario, amount_owed),
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Final answer predicate (deterministic)
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    scenario_id(S),
    summons_must_state_amount_owed(S),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%
%% Main entrypoint
%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%%

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: Is it required that the evictions summons served to tenants state the amount owed by the tenant?
